product_brief: A module lattice-based signature scheme for shorter and easily maskable signatures, targeting space-limited scenarios like DNSSEC.
pqc_capability_description: HAETAE is a module lattice-based signature scheme guaranteeing quantum security in the QROM. It uses the Fiat-Shamir with Aborts paradigm, bimodal distribution for rejection sampling, and hyperball uniform sampling. It aims for reduced signature and verification key sizes.
implementation_attack_surface: Mentions avoiding SCA-vulnerable discrete Gaussian distributions by using hyperball uniform sampling; mentions "easily maskable signatures".
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Designed for space-limited scenarios such as DNSSEC; targets reducing signature/verification key sizes to fit into one TCP or UDP datagram.
